ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 10% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface, characterized by a dominant light central field and dark peripheral borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; solid black pigmentation band (width varying 15-40 pixels) along the entire trailing edge; distinctive hook-shaped black cluster on the lower quadrant of the right lobe; small dark punctate mottling near the central peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks varies from 3-10 pixels; highest concentration of jagged irregular topography observed on the medial section of the right lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges meeting at the central notch; outer edges exhibit an upward and outward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-relief, orange-brown textured pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by roughly circular sub-units.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible; two prominent diagonal marks on the upper-left lobe; several horizontal linear tracks across the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological fouling/barnacle colonization on both distal tips; prominent 'S' or hook-shaped dark pigmentation mark on the lower right lobe; vertical rake-like marks on the upper left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique orange-hued calcified texture present on the distal points, contrasting with the standard black/white pigmentation of the fluke surface.
